"""Pixel-preserving, locked-camera RGB reconstruction and analytic drop animation.
Uses no assets other than the supplied first frame and task specification.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt, gaussian_filter
import cv2
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = np.array(Image.open(ROOT / 'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
H, W = SOURCE.shape[:2]
SRC = SOURCE.astype(np.float32)


def smooth(x):
    x = np.clip(x, 0., 1.)
    return x * x * (3. - 2. * x)


def wall_fit(box, kind):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    rgb = SRC[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    if kind == 'ball':
        good = (((xx-421)/79.)**2 + ((yy-165)/80.)**2 > 1.)
        good &= rgb[..., 1] > 105
        good &= ~((yy < 150) & ((xx < 367) | (xx > 470)))
    elif kind == 'block':
        good = (xx < 1045) | (xx > 1117) | (yy > 329) | (yy < 156)
        good &= rgb[..., 1] > 85
    elif kind == 'left_tool':
        good = (rgb[..., 0] > 110) & (rgb[..., 1] > 105)
        good &= ~((((xx-421)/79.)**2 + ((yy-165)/85.)**2 < 1.))
    else:
        good = (yy > 157) | ((xx > 1143) & (yy > 85)) | ((xx < 1015) & (yy > 132))
        good &= rgb[..., 1] > 80
    x = (xx - (x0+x1)*.5)/200.
    y = (yy - (y0+y1)*.5)/200.
    design = np.stack([x*0+1, x, y, x*x, x*y, y*y, x*x*x, x*x*y, x*y*y, y*y*y], -1)
    coef = np.linalg.lstsq(design[good], rgb[good], rcond=None)[0]
    return (design @ coef).astype(np.float32)


class Layer:
    def __init__(self, box, alpha, delta, bg, center):
        self.box = box
        self.center = np.array(center, np.float32)
        self.local_center = self.center - np.array(box[:2], np.float32)
        self.delta = delta
        self.rgba = np.concatenate([delta + alpha[..., None]*bg, alpha[..., None]], -1).astype(np.float32)

    def composite(self, image, center=None, angle=0., scale=(1., 1.), gain=1.):
        center = self.center if center is None else np.asarray(center)
        c, s = np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)
        mat = np.array([[c*scale[0], -s*scale[1]], [s*scale[0], c*scale[1]]], np.float32)
        ht, wd = self.rgba.shape[:2]
        corners = np.array([[0,0],[wd,0],[wd,ht],[0,ht]], np.float32)
        corners = (corners - self.local_center) @ mat.T + center
        lo = np.floor(corners.min(0)-2).astype(int)
        hi = np.ceil(corners.max(0)+2).astype(int)
        lo = np.maximum(lo, [0, 0]); hi = np.minimum(hi, [W, H])
        if np.any(hi <= lo):
            return
        aff = np.column_stack([mat, center-lo-mat@self.local_center]).astype(np.float32)
        patch = cv2.warpAffine(self.rgba, aff, tuple((hi-lo).tolist()), flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
                               borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT, borderValue=0)
        a = np.clip(patch[..., 3:4], 0., 1.)
        dest = image[lo[1]:hi[1], lo[0]:hi[0]]
        dest *= 1.-a
        dest += patch[..., :3]*gain


def object_layer(kind):
    if kind == 'ball':
        box = (300, 75, 550, 263)
        center = (421., 165.)
    else:
        box = (1010, 150, 1155, 355)
        center = (1081., 242.)
    bg = wall_fit(box, kind)
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = box
    yy,xx = np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    rgb = SRC[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    if kind == 'ball':
        core = ((xx-421)/52.)**2 + ((yy-165)/45.)**2 < 1.
        region = smooth((1.12-np.sqrt(((xx-421)/70.)**2+((yy-165)/79.)**2))/.15)
        region *= smooth((yy-90)/4.)
        # Do not turn the blue jaw edges into part of the brown sphere.
        region *= np.where((yy < 150) & (rgb[...,2] > rgb[...,0]+4), 0., 1.)
    else:
        core = (xx >= 1064) & (xx <= 1096) & (yy >= 202) & (yy <= 284)
        region = smooth((xx-1050)/5.)*smooth((1113-xx)/6.)
        region *= smooth((yy-165)/6.)*smooth((322-yy)/7.)
    _, inds = distance_transform_edt(~core, return_indices=True)
    fg = rgb[inds[0], inds[1]]
    v = fg[...,1:]-bg[...,1:]
    d = rgb[...,1:]-bg[...,1:]
    alpha = np.clip(np.sum(v*d,-1)/(np.sum(v*v,-1)+1e-6), 0., 1.)
    alpha[core] = 1.
    alpha *= region
    support = smooth((alpha-.012)/.025) * region
    delta = (rgb-bg)*support[...,None]
    alpha *= smooth((alpha-.009)/.025)
    return Layer(box, alpha, delta, bg, center)


def tool_layer(side):
    if side in ('left', 'right'):
        box = (298, 60, 530, 175)
        bg = wall_fit(box, 'left_tool')
        x0,y0,x1,y1 = box
        yy,xx = np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]
        rgb = SRC[y0:y1,x0:x1]
        if side == 'left':
            region = smooth((xx-307)/5.)*smooth((378-xx)/6.)
        else:
            region = smooth((xx-449)/6.)*smooth((513-xx)/6.)
        region *= smooth((yy-75)/5.) * smooth((156-yy)/6.)
        # The warm-colored ball lies behind the two blue jaws, not in their matte.
        color = smooth((rgb[...,2]-rgb[...,0]-1)/5.)
        depth = smooth((bg[...,0]-rgb[...,0]-3)/6.)
        region *= color*depth
        alpha = np.clip((bg[...,0]-rgb[...,0]) / (bg[...,0]-5), 0, 1)*region
        support = smooth((alpha-.012)/.025)*region
        delta = (rgb-bg)*support[...,None]
        layer = Layer(box, alpha, delta, bg, (0.,0.))
        layer.yy = yy
        layer.xx = xx
        layer.side = side
        return layer
    box = (945, 55, 1170, 177)
    bg = wall_fit(box, 'right_tool')
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = box
    yy,xx = np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    rgb = SRC[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    region = smooth((xx-1045)/12.)*smooth((1144-xx)/7.)
    region *= smooth((yy-100)/9.)*smooth((161-yy)/7.)
    alpha = np.clip((bg[...,1]-rgb[...,1])/(bg[...,1]-23),0,1)*region
    support = smooth((alpha-.025)/.05)*region
    delta = (rgb-bg)*support[...,None]
    layer = Layer(box,alpha,delta,bg,(0.,0.))
    layer.yy=yy; layer.xx=xx; layer.side='orange'
    return layer


def place_tool(image, layer, opening):
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = layer.box
    yy,xx = np.mgrid[y0-12:y1+12,x0-24:x1+24].astype(np.float32)
    if layer.side == 'orange':
        amount = smooth((yy-99)/48.)*smooth((xx-1044)/65.)
        dx = 5.5*opening*amount
        dy = -7.5*opening*amount
    else:
        amount = smooth((yy-76)/73.)
        dx = (-16. if layer.side=='left' else 15.)*opening*amount
        dy = -1.6*opening*amount
    mx = xx-dx-x0; my = yy-dy-y0
    rgba = cv2.remap(layer.rgba,mx,my,cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
    dest = image[y0-12:y1+12,x0-24:x1+24]
    dest *= 1.-rgba[...,3:4]
    dest += rgba[...,:3]


BALL = object_layer('ball')
BLOCK = object_layer('block')
TOOLS = [tool_layer('left'), tool_layer('right'), tool_layer('orange')]
CLEAN = SRC.copy()
for layer in [BALL,BLOCK]+TOOLS:
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = layer.box
    CLEAN[y0:y1,x0:x1] -= layer.delta

# Gravity is expressed in pixels per second squared at the fixed demonstration scale.
G = 1450.
RELEASE_BALL, RELEASE_BLOCK = .32, .34
BALL_SURFACE, BLOCK_SURFACE = 565., 566.
BALL_R = 57.
BLOCK_HALF_H, BLOCK_HALF_W = 56., 21.
BALL_CONTACT = RELEASE_BALL + math.sqrt(2*(BALL_SURFACE-BALL_R-165.)/G)
# A small lean develops in free fall, then the tall block tips over its lowest corner.
BLOCK_LEAN = math.radians(9.)
BLOCK_BOTTOM = BLOCK_HALF_H*math.cos(BLOCK_LEAN)+BLOCK_HALF_W*math.sin(BLOCK_LEAN)
BLOCK_CONTACT = RELEASE_BLOCK + math.sqrt(2*(BLOCK_SURFACE-BLOCK_BOTTOM-242.)/G)
BV = G*(BALL_CONTACT-RELEASE_BALL)
OV = G*(BLOCK_CONTACT-RELEASE_BLOCK)

# Integrate the elementary torque equation of a bar pivoting on its lower corner.
TIP_DT = 1/480.
angles = [BLOCK_LEAN]
omega = .24
flat_time = None
for k in range(1,1000):
    theta=angles[-1]
    omega += TIP_DT*(3*G/(2*112.)*math.sin(theta)-1.7*omega)
    theta += TIP_DT*omega
    if theta >= math.pi/2:
        flat_time = k*TIP_DT
        angles.append(math.pi/2)
        break
    angles.append(theta)
angles=np.array(angles)


def ball_pose(t):
    if t < RELEASE_BALL:
        return (421.,165.),0.,(1.,1.),0.,0.
    if t < BALL_CONTACT:
        dt=t-RELEASE_BALL
        return (421.+1.8*dt,165.+.5*G*dt*dt),.045*dt,(1.,1.),0.,G*dt
    q=t-BALL_CONTACT
    penetration=7.5*(1-math.exp(-14*q))+(BV/31.)*math.exp(-13*q)*math.sin(31*q)
    # Mild radial squash and a dissipative, very small horizontal roll.
    squash=.043*math.exp(-15*q)*max(0.,math.sin(30*q))
    x=422.2+11.5*(1-math.exp(-2.7*q))
    angle=.03+(x-422.2)/57.
    y=BALL_SURFACE+penetration-BALL_R*(1-squash)
    return (x,y),angle,(1+squash,1-squash),max(penetration,0.),0.


def block_pose(t):
    if t < RELEASE_BLOCK:
        return (1081.,242.),0.,(1.,1.),0.,0.
    if t < BLOCK_CONTACT:
        dt=t-RELEASE_BLOCK
        p=dt/(BLOCK_CONTACT-RELEASE_BLOCK)
        angle=BLOCK_LEAN*p*p
        return (1081.+1.1*p,242.+.5*G*dt*dt),angle,(1.,1.),0.,G*dt
    q=t-BLOCK_CONTACT
    pen=5.*(1-math.exp(-18*q))+(OV/36.)*math.exp(-18*q)*math.sin(36*q)
    tip_q=max(0.,q-.045)
    if tip_q < flat_time:
        f=tip_q/TIP_DT
        k=min(int(f),len(angles)-2)
        a=angles[k]*(1-(f-k))+angles[k+1]*(f-k)
    else:
        u=tip_q-flat_time
        a=math.pi/2-math.radians(2.2)*math.exp(-11*u)*math.sin(25*u)
        pen+=3.5*math.exp(-13*u)*math.sin(27*u)
    # Fix the contacting corner on the cushion, rather than rotating around the center.
    px=1082.1+BLOCK_HALF_W*math.cos(BLOCK_LEAN)-BLOCK_HALF_H*math.sin(BLOCK_LEAN)
    cx=px-BLOCK_HALF_W*math.cos(a)+BLOCK_HALF_H*math.sin(a)
    cy=BLOCK_SURFACE+pen-BLOCK_HALF_W*math.sin(a)-BLOCK_HALF_H*math.cos(a)
    return (cx,cy),a,(1.,1.),max(pen,0.),0.


def deform_pillow(image, cx, cy, amount, width, depth):
    if amount < .01:
        return
    x0=max(0,int(cx-width*2.8)); x1=min(W,int(cx+width*2.8))
    y0=max(470,int(cy-depth*2.6)); y1=min(H,int(cy+depth*3.4))
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(np.float32)
    u=(xx-cx)/width; v=(yy-cy)/depth
    weight=np.exp(-.5*(u*u+v*v))
    # Inverse warp gives a local indentation while every other part of the table stays locked.
    dy=amount*weight
    dx=amount*.11*u*weight
    roi=image[y0:y1,x0:x1].copy()
    out=cv2.remap(roi,xx-x0-dx,yy-y0-dy,cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT_101)
    crease=np.exp(-.5*((u/.75)**2+((v-.12)/.7)**2))
    out*=1.-min(amount/260.,.06)*crease[...,None]
    image[y0:y1,x0:x1]=out


def shadow(image,cx,cy,rx,ry,opacity):
    if opacity <= 0:
        return
    x0=max(0,int(cx-3*rx));x1=min(W,int(cx+3*rx))
    y0=max(0,int(cy-3*ry));y1=min(H,int(cy+3*ry))
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(np.float32)
    shape=np.exp(-.5*(((xx-cx)/rx)**2+((yy-cy)/ry)**2))
    image[y0:y1,x0:x1]*=1.-opacity*shape[...,None]


def render(t):
    opening=float(smooth((t-.115)/.245))
    image=CLEAN.copy()
    bp=ball_pose(t);op=block_pose(t)
    # Contact response of the cloth is subtle, localized, and rapidly damped.
    deform_pillow(image,bp[0][0],BALL_SURFACE,bp[3]*.47,64.,33.)
    block_shadow_x=op[0][0]
    deform_pillow(image,block_shadow_x,BLOCK_SURFACE,op[3]*.44,48.+24*math.sin(op[1]),27.)
    if t > RELEASE_BALL:
        height=max(0.,BALL_SURFACE-(bp[0][1]+BALL_R))
        closeness=math.exp(-height/125.)*float(smooth((t-RELEASE_BALL)/.13))
        shadow(image,bp[0][0]+7,BALL_SURFACE+4,42.+height*.055,10.+height*.045,.21*closeness)
        shadow(image,bp[0][0]+2,BALL_SURFACE+bp[3]+1,28.,5.5,.20*math.exp(-height/20.))
    if t > RELEASE_BLOCK:
        foot=op[0][1]+BLOCK_HALF_W*abs(math.sin(op[1]))+BLOCK_HALF_H*abs(math.cos(op[1]))
        height=max(0.,BLOCK_SURFACE-foot)
        closeness=math.exp(-height/110.)*float(smooth((t-RELEASE_BLOCK)/.13))
        width=18.+35.*abs(math.sin(op[1]))
        shadow(image,op[0][0]+5,BLOCK_SURFACE+4,width+height*.05,7.+height*.033,.26*closeness)
        shadow(image,op[0][0]+1,BLOCK_SURFACE+op[3]+2,width*.8,4.,.20*math.exp(-height/18.))
    for tool in TOOLS:
        place_tool(image,tool,opening)
    # Short exposure integration only during the fast part of each drop.
    blur=max(bp[4],op[4])>240.
    times=[t-1/160.,t,t+1/160.] if blur else [t]
    if blur:
        background=image
        accum=np.zeros_like(image)
        for sample in times:
            canvas=background.copy()
            p=ball_pose(sample);r=block_pose(sample)
            gain=1.+.065*float(smooth((sample-RELEASE_BALL)/.55))
            BALL.composite(canvas,p[0],p[1],p[2],gain)
            BLOCK.composite(canvas,r[0],r[1],r[2],1.)
            accum+=canvas
        image=accum/len(times)
    else:
        gain=1.+.065*float(smooth((t-RELEASE_BALL)/.55))
        BALL.composite(image,bp[0],bp[1],bp[2],gain)
        BLOCK.composite(image,op[0],op[1],op[2],1.)
    return np.clip(np.rint(image),0,255).astype(np.uint8)


def main():
    spec=json.loads((ROOT/'task_spec.json').read_text())
    n,fps=spec['frames'],spec['fps']
    assert (W,H)==(spec['width'],spec['height'])
    frames=np.empty((n,H,W,3),np.uint8)
    frames[0]=SOURCE
    for i in range(1,n):
        if i/fps <= .115:
            frames[i]=SOURCE
        else:
            frames[i]=render(i/fps)
        if i%24==0:
            print(f'Rendered {i}/{n} frames',flush=True)
    assert np.array_equal(frames[0],SOURCE)
    print('Saving required RGB artifacts...',flush=True)
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
    # A compact, conventional playback copy supplements the exact RGB frame artifacts.
    try:
        import imageio_ffmpeg
        generator=imageio_ffmpeg.write_frames(str(ROOT/'video.mp4'),(W,H),fps=fps,
                    codec='libx264',pix_fmt_in='rgb24',pix_fmt_out='yuv420p',quality=9,
                    macro_block_size=1,ffmpeg_log_level='error')
        generator.send(None)
        for frame in frames:
            generator.send(np.ascontiguousarray(frame))
        generator.close()
    except Exception as exc:
        print('Optional MP4 export:',exc,flush=True)
    print('Complete: 120 RGB frames, pixels.npz, and local playback.',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

\"\"\"Pixel-preserving, locked-camera RGB reconstruction and analytic drop animation.
Uses no assets other than the supplied first frame and task specification.

from pathlib import Path
import json
import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import distance_transform_edt, gaussian_filter
import cv2
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = np.array(Image.open(ROOT / 'first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
H, W = SOURCE.shape[:2]
SRC = SOURCE.astype(np.float32)


def smooth(x):
    x = np.clip(x, 0., 1.)
    return x * x * (3. - 2. * x)


def wall_fit(box, kind):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    rgb = SRC[y0:y1, x0:x1]
    if kind == 'ball':
        good = (((xx-421)/79.)**2 + ((yy-165)/80.)**2 > 1.)
        good &= rgb[..., 1] > 105
        good &= ~((yy < 150) & ((xx < 367) | (xx > 470)))
    elif kind == 'block':
        good = (xx < 1045) | (xx > 1117) | (yy > 329) | (yy < 156)
        good &= rgb[..., 1] > 85
    elif kind == 'left_tool':
        good = (rgb[..., 0] > 110) & (rgb[..., 1] > 105)
        good &= ~((((xx-421)/79.)**2 + ((yy-165)/85.)**2 < 1.))
    else:
        good = (yy > 157) | ((xx > 1143) & (yy > 85)) | ((xx < 1015) & (yy > 132))
        good &= rgb[..., 1] > 80
    x = (xx - (x0+x1)*.5)/200.
    y = (yy - (y0+y1)*.5)/200.
    design = np.stack([x*0+1, x, y, x*x, x*y, y*y, x*x*x, x*x*y, x*y*y, y*y*y], -1)
    coef = np.linalg.lstsq(design[good], rgb[good], rcond=None)[0]
    return (design @ coef).astype(np.float32)


class Layer:
    def __init__(self, box, alpha, delta, bg, center):
        self.box = box
        self.center = np.array(center, np.float32)
        self.local_center = self.center - np.array(box[:2], np.float32)
        self.delta = delta
        self.rgba = np.concatenate([delta + alpha[..., None]*bg, alpha[..., None]], -1).astype(np.float32)

    def composite(self, image, center=None, angle=0., scale=(1., 1.), gain=1.):
        center = self.center if center is None else np.asarray(center)
        c, s = np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)
        mat = np.array([[c*scale[0], -s*scale[1]], [s*scale[0], c*scale[1]]], np.float32)
        ht, wd = self.rgba.shape[:2]
        corners = np.array([[0,0],[wd,0],[wd,ht],[0,ht]], np.float32)
        corners = (corners - self.local_center) @ mat.T + center
        lo = np.floor(corners.min(0)-2).astype(int)
        hi = np.ceil(corners.max(0)+2).astype(int)
        lo = np.maximum(lo, [0, 0]); hi = np.minimum(hi, [W, H])
        if np.any(hi <= lo):
            return
        aff = np.column_stack([mat, center-lo-mat@self.local_center]).astype(np.float32)
        patch = cv2.warpAffine(self.rgba, aff, tuple((hi-lo).tolist()), flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
                               borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT, borderValue=0)
        a = np.clip(patch[..., 3:4], 0., 1.)
        dest = image[lo[1]:hi[1], lo[0]:hi[0]]
        dest *= 1.-a
        dest += patch[..., :3]*gain


def object_layer(kind):
    if kind == 'ball':
        box = (300, 75, 550, 263)
        center = (421., 165.)
    else:
        box = (1010, 150, 1155, 355)
        center = (1081., 242.)
    bg = wall_fit(box, kind)
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = box
    yy,xx = np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    rgb = SRC[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    if kind == 'ball':
        core = ((xx-421)/52.)**2 + ((yy-165)/45.)**2 < 1.
        region = smooth((1.12-np.sqrt(((xx-421)/70.)**2+((yy-165)/79.)**2))/.15)
        region *= smooth((yy-90)/4.)
        # Do not turn the blue jaw edges into part of the brown sphere.
        region *= np.where((yy < 150) & (rgb[...,2] > rgb[...,0]+4), 0., 1.)
    else:
        core = (xx >= 1064) & (xx <= 1096) & (yy >= 202) & (yy <= 284)
        region = smooth((xx-1050)/5.)*smooth((1113-xx)/6.)
        region *= smooth((yy-165)/6.)*smooth((322-yy)/7.)
    _, inds = distance_transform_edt(~core, return_indices=True)
    fg = rgb[inds[0], inds[1]]
    v = fg[...,1:]-bg[...,1:]
    d = rgb[...,1:]-bg[...,1:]
    alpha = np.clip(np.sum(v*d,-1)/(np.sum(v*v,-1)+1e-6), 0., 1.)
    alpha[core] = 1.
    alpha *= region
    support = smooth((alpha-.012)/.025) * region
    delta = (rgb-bg)*support[...,None]
    alpha *= smooth((alpha-.009)/.025)
    return Layer(box, alpha, delta, bg, center)


def tool_layer(side):
    if side in ('left', 'right'):
        box = (298, 60, 530, 175)
        bg = wall_fit(box, 'left_tool')
        x0,y0,x1,y1 = box
        yy,xx = np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]
        rgb = SRC[y0:y1,x0:x1]
        if side == 'left':
            region = smooth((xx-307)/5.)*smooth((378-xx)/6.)
        else:
            region = smooth((xx-449)/6.)*smooth((513-xx)/6.)
        region *= smooth((yy-75)/5.) * smooth((156-yy)/6.)
        # The warm-colored ball lies behind the two blue jaws, not in their matte.
        color = smooth((rgb[...,2]-rgb[...,0]-1)/5.)
        depth = smooth((bg[...,0]-rgb[...,0]-3)/6.)
        region *= color*depth
        alpha = np.clip((bg[...,0]-rgb[...,0]) / (bg[...,0]-5), 0, 1)*region
        support = smooth((alpha-.012)/.025)*region
        delta = (rgb-bg)*support[...,None]
        layer = Layer(box, alpha, delta, bg, (0.,0.))
        layer.yy = yy
        layer.xx = xx
        layer.side = side
        return layer
    box = (945, 55, 1170, 177)
    bg = wall_fit(box, 'right_tool')
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = box
    yy,xx = np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    rgb = SRC[y0:y1,x0:x1]
    region = smooth((xx-1045)/12.)*smooth((1144-xx)/7.)
    region *= smooth((yy-100)/9.)*smooth((161-yy)/7.)
    alpha = np.clip((bg[...,1]-rgb[...,1])/(bg[...,1]-23),0,1)*region
    support = smooth((alpha-.025)/.05)*region
    delta = (rgb-bg)*support[...,None]
    layer = Layer(box,alpha,delta,bg,(0.,0.))
    layer.yy=yy; layer.xx=xx; layer.side='orange'
    return layer


def place_tool(image, layer, opening):
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = layer.box
    yy,xx = np.mgrid[y0-12:y1+12,x0-24:x1+24].astype(np.float32)
    if layer.side == 'orange':
        amount = smooth((yy-99)/48.)*smooth((xx-1044)/65.)
        dx = 5.5*opening*amount
        dy = -7.5*opening*amount
    else:
        amount = smooth((yy-76)/73.)
        dx = (-16. if layer.side=='left' else 15.)*opening*amount
        dy = -1.6*opening*amount
    mx = xx-dx-x0; my = yy-dy-y0
    rgba = cv2.remap(layer.rgba,mx,my,cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
    dest = image[y0-12:y1+12,x0-24:x1+24]
    dest *= 1.-rgba[...,3:4]
    dest += rgba[...,:3]


BALL = object_layer('ball')
BLOCK = object_layer('block')
TOOLS = [tool_layer('left'), tool_layer('right'), tool_layer('orange')]
CLEAN = SRC.copy()
for layer in [BALL,BLOCK]+TOOLS:
    x0,y0,x1,y1 = layer.box
    CLEAN[y0:y1,x0:x1] -= layer.delta

# Gravity is expressed in pixels per second squared at the fixed demonstration scale.
G = 1450.
RELEASE_BALL, RELEASE_BLOCK = .32, .34
BALL_SURFACE, BLOCK_SURFACE = 565., 566.
BALL_R = 57.
BLOCK_HALF_H, BLOCK_HALF_W = 56., 21.
BALL_CONTACT = RELEASE_BALL + math.sqrt(2*(BALL_SURFACE-BALL_R-165.)/G)
# A small lean develops in free fall, then the tall block tips over its lowest corner.
BLOCK_LEAN = math.radians(9.)
BLOCK_BOTTOM = BLOCK_HALF_H*math.cos(BLOCK_LEAN)+BLOCK_HALF_W*math.sin(BLOCK_LEAN)
BLOCK_CONTACT = RELEASE_BLOCK + math.sqrt(2*(BLOCK_SURFACE-BLOCK_BOTTOM-242.)/G)
BV = G*(BALL_CONTACT-RELEASE_BALL)
OV = G*(BLOCK_CONTACT-RELEASE_BLOCK)

# Integrate the elementary torque equation of a bar pivoting on its lower corner.
TIP_DT = 1/480.
angles = [BLOCK_LEAN]
omega = .24
flat_time = None
for k in range(1,1000):
    theta=angles[-1]
    omega += TIP_DT*(3*G/(2*112.)*math.sin(theta)-1.7*omega)
    theta += TIP_DT*omega
    if theta >= math.pi/2:
        flat_time = k*TIP_DT
        angles.append(math.pi/2)
        break
    angles.append(theta)
angles=np.array(angles)


def ball_pose(t):
    if t < RELEASE_BALL:
        return (421.,165.),0.,(1.,1.),0.,0.
    if t < BALL_CONTACT:
        dt=t-RELEASE_BALL
        return (421.+1.8*dt,165.+.5*G*dt*dt),.045*dt,(1.,1.),0.,G*dt
    q=t-BALL_CONTACT
    penetration=7.5*(1-math.exp(-14*q))+(BV/31.)*math.exp(-13*q)*math.sin(31*q)
    # Mild radial squash and a dissipative, very small horizontal roll.
    squash=.043*math.exp(-15*q)*max(0.,math.sin(30*q))
    x=422.2+11.5*(1-math.exp(-2.7*q))
    angle=.03+(x-422.2)/57.
    y=BALL_SURFACE+penetration-BALL_R*(1-squash)
    return (x,y),angle,(1+squash,1-squash),max(penetration,0.),0.


def block_pose(t):
    if t < RELEASE_BLOCK:
        return (1081.,242.),0.,(1.,1.),0.,0.
    if t < BLOCK_CONTACT:
        dt=t-RELEASE_BLOCK
        p=dt/(BLOCK_CONTACT-RELEASE_BLOCK)
        angle=BLOCK_LEAN*p*p
        return (1081.+1.1*p,242.+.5*G*dt*dt),angle,(1.,1.),0.,G*dt
    q=t-BLOCK_CONTACT
    pen=5.*(1-math.exp(-18*q))+(OV/36.)*math.exp(-18*q)*math.sin(36*q)
    tip_q=max(0.,q-.045)
    if tip_q < flat_time:
        f=tip_q/TIP_DT
        k=min(int(f),len(angles)-2)
        a=angles[k]*(1-(f-k))+angles[k+1]*(f-k)
    else:
        u=tip_q-flat_time
        a=math.pi/2-math.radians(2.2)*math.exp(-11*u)*math.sin(25*u)
        pen+=3.5*math.exp(-13*u)*math.sin(27*u)
    # Fix the contacting corner on the cushion, rather than rotating around the center.
    px=1082.1+BLOCK_HALF_W*math.cos(BLOCK_LEAN)-BLOCK_HALF_H*math.sin(BLOCK_LEAN)
    cx=px-BLOCK_HALF_W*math.cos(a)+BLOCK_HALF_H*math.sin(a)
    cy=BLOCK_SURFACE+pen-BLOCK_HALF_W*math.sin(a)-BLOCK_HALF_H*math.cos(a)
    return (cx,cy),a,(1.,1.),max(pen,0.),0.


def deform_pillow(image, cx, cy, amount, width, depth):
    if amount < .01:
        return
    x0=max(0,int(cx-width*2.8)); x1=min(W,int(cx+width*2.8))
    y0=max(470,int(cy-depth*2.6)); y1=min(H,int(cy+depth*3.4))
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(np.float32)
    u=(xx-cx)/width; v=(yy-cy)/depth
    weight=np.exp(-.5*(u*u+v*v))
    # Inverse warp gives a local indentation while every other part of the table stays locked.
    dy=amount*weight
    dx=amount*.11*u*weight
    roi=image[y0:y1,x0:x1].copy()
    out=cv2.remap(roi,xx-x0-dx,yy-y0-dy,cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT_101)
    crease=np.exp(-.5*((u/.75)**2+((v-.12)/.7)**2))
    out*=1.-min(amount/260.,.06)*crease[...,None]
    image[y0:y1,x0:x1]=out


def shadow(image,cx,cy,rx,ry,opacity):
    if opacity <= 0:
        return
    x0=max(0,int(cx-3*rx));x1=min(W,int(cx+3*rx))
    y0=max(0,int(cy-3*ry));y1=min(H,int(cy+3*ry))
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[y0:y1,x0:x1].astype(np.float32)
    shape=np.exp(-.5*(((xx-cx)/rx)**2+((yy-cy)/ry)**2))
    image[y0:y1,x0:x1]*=1.-opacity*shape[...,None]

    image=CLEAN.copy()
    bp=ball_pose(t);op=block_pose(t)
    # Contact response of the cloth is subtle, localized, and rapidly damped.
    deform_pillow(image,bp[0][0],BALL_SURFACE,bp[3]*.47,64.,33.)
    block_shadow_x=op[0][0]
    deform_pillow(image,block_shadow_x,BLOCK_SURFACE,op[3]*.44,48.+24*math.sin(op[1]),27.)
    if t > RELEASE_BALL:
        height=max(0.,BALL_SURFACE-(bp[0][1]+BALL_R))
        closeness=math.exp(-height/125.)*float(smooth((t-RELEASE_BALL)/.13))
        shadow(image,bp[0][0]+7,BALL_SURFACE+4,42.+height*.055,10.+height*.045,.21*closeness)
        shadow(image,bp[0][0]+2,BALL_SURFACE+bp[3]+1,28.,5.5,.20*math.exp(-height/20.))
    if t > RELEASE_BLOCK:
        foot=op[0][1]+BLOCK_HALF_W*abs(math.sin(op[1]))+BLOCK_HALF_H*abs(math.cos(op[1]))
        height=max(0.,BLOCK_SURFACE-foot)
        closeness=math.exp(-height/110.)*float(smooth((t-RELEASE_BLOCK)/.13))
        width=18.+35.*abs(math.sin(op[1]))
        shadow(image,op[0][0]+5,BLOCK_SURFACE+4,width+height*.05,7.+height*.033,.26*closeness)
        shadow(image,op[0][0]+1,BLOCK_SURFACE+op[3]+2,width*.8,4.,.20*math.exp(-height/18.))
    for tool in TOOLS:
        place_tool(image,tool,opening)
    # Short exposure integration only during the fast part of each drop.
    blur=max(bp[4],op[4])>240.
    times=[t-1/160.,t,t+1/160.] if blur else [t]
    if blur:
        background=image
        accum=np.zeros_like(image)
        for sample in times:
            canvas=background.copy()
            p=ball_pose(sample);r=block_pose(sample)
            gain=1.+.065*float(smooth((sample-RELEASE_BALL)/.55))
            BALL.composite(canvas,p[0],p[1],p[2],gain)
            BLOCK.composite(canvas,r[0],r[1],r[2],1.)
            accum+=canvas
        image=accum/len(times)
    else:
        gain=1.+.065*float(smooth((t-RELEASE_BALL)/.55))
        BALL.composite(image,bp[0],bp[1],bp[2],gain)
        BLOCK.composite(image,op[0],op[1],op[2],1.)
    return np.clip(np.rint(image),0,255).astype(np.uint8)


def main():
    spec=json.loads((ROOT/'task_spec.json').read_text())
    n,fps=spec['frames'],spec['fps']
    assert (W,H)==(spec['width'],spec['height'])
    frames=np.empty((n,H,W,3),np.uint8)
    frames[0]=SOURCE
    for i in range(1,n):
        if i/fps <= .115:
            frames[i]=SOURCE
        else:
            frames[i]=render(i/fps)
        if i%24==0:
            print(f'Rendered {i}/{n} frames',flush=True)
    assert np.array_equal(frames[0],SOURCE)
    print('Saving required RGB artifacts...',flush=True)
    artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
    # A compact, conventional playback copy supplements the exact RGB frame artifacts.
    try:
        import imageio_ffmpeg
        generator=imageio_ffmpeg.write_frames(str(ROOT/'video.mp4'),(W,H),fps=fps,
                    codec='libx264',pix_fmt_in='rgb24',pix_fmt_out='yuv420p',quality=9,
                    macro_block_size=1,ffmpeg_log_level='error')
        generator.send(None)
        for frame in frames:
            generator.send(np.ascontiguousarray(frame))
        generator.close()
    except Exception as exc:
        print('Optional MP4 export:',exc,flush=True)
    print('Complete: 120 RGB frames, pixels.npz, and local playback.',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
